segments.speaker: CISO Sarah
segments.text: Welcome to the 2026 Security Onboarding. Remember that every security anomaly or suspicious email must be reported to our SOC within sixty minutes.

segments.speaker: Security Architect Alex
segments.text: When setting up your workstation, our device policy automatically enforces a 5 minute screen lock and blocks unapproved USB flash storage devices.

segments.speaker: Security Architect Alex
segments.text: For remote access, use our FIDO2 hardware tokens. Passwords must be at least 14 characters, and your account locks after five failed attempts.

segments.speaker: Compliance Manager David
segments.text: All audit logs are preserved in immutable storage for 365 days. If a device is stolen, notify security operations within two hours so we can trigger a remote wipe.

segments.speaker: CISO Sarah
segments.text: Finally, all vendor contracts require a signed Data Protection Addendum and an annual SOC 2 Type II audit. Thank you for keeping our infrastructure secure.
